business_summary: Zhejiang Guyuelongshan Shaoxing Wine Co.,Ltd engages in the research, brewing, production and sale of rice and white wine and edible alcohol in China and internationally. It offers its products under the Guyue Longshan, Jianhu, Zhuangyuanhong, Daughter Red, and Shen Yonghe brands. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Shaoxing, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhejiang Guyuelongshan Shaoxing Wine Co.,Ltd는 중국 및 국제적으로 쌀, 백포도주, 식용 알코올의 연구, 양조, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. Guyue Longshan, Jianhu, Zhuangyuanhong, Daughter Red 및 Shen Yonghe 브랜드로 제품을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 1997년에 설립되었으며 중국 소흥(Shaoxing)에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
